The capital of France is Paris.

Regarding the thematic structure of "Beneath a Scarlet Sky," the author's motive to highlight overlooked individual heroism is directly linked to the themes of bravery, sacrifice, and the harsh realities of conflict. By focusing on these specific elements, the author constructs a narrative framework that elevates the personal experiences of the protagonist, thereby serving the broader purpose of honoring the unsung heroes of war and integrating their stories into the larger historical narrative.
